entities.evidence_span: Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins.
Because some amino acids are not produced by the body, they must be consumed through the food. These amino acids are referred to as essential amino acids.
Some amino acids are generated in the body and do not require supplementation; these amino acids are referred to as non-essential amino acids.
Some amino acids are generated in the body, but production is insufficient; these amino acids are referred to as semi-essential amino acids.
